scope: R12 CAUR-FIT DEVELOPMENT, all 18 canonical instances; never an untouched final test
sources: H1 once per instance, plus NATIVE16 for each canonical root; native policy with eight repair trials
sampling: complete 24-rule bank at each size; mandatory critical-sync plus one cyclic rule from each of five groups, including a second original operator; cross all five repairs; deduplicate exact actions
paired_label_semantics: unchanged V2 T8_R9; new development state IDs give disjoint CRN keys; fallback cached per state/replicate
folds: (scale_index + CF_index) mod 3, S/M/L and CF1/2/3 indexed 0..2; both cell replicates always in same fold

critic.prediction: joint continuation advantage plus beats-fallback logit

training.batching: one complete state and all its labeled actions; equal instance contribution
training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch; OOF labels never select epochs or checkpoints
training.production_model: one model fit to all development instances only after OOF gate; fixed seed and architecture
